input.body:
A short list of nits from our design team after a week of use:
- the sidebar collapse animation stutters on Safari
- the empty state illustration is off-centre on tablet
- table headers lose their border when you scroll horizontally
- the avatar stack overlaps oddly at exactly five members
None of these block anyone, they are just papercuts we noticed. Also, since about 09:00 today nobody in our organisation can load the app at all - it hangs on the loading spinner forever on every browser and every machine we have tried. Probably related to the same release?
input.subject: Minor UI polish suggestions
